title: Record that rank 3 blocks a universal length-30 singleton word
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->
## Change and mathematical scope

Scoped partial obstruction. No new κ and no selected-frontier change. Selected κ stays `781451/250000000`.

In the restored binary singleton model, `28 <= f(8) <= 32` is unchanged. For a closed eight-source word of length 30, every admissible multiplicity vector has a source of multiplicity 2. This package proves:

- Outside a rank-r sojourn flat, `Q0 + Q0` must cover `128 - 2^r` nonzero vectors, so `|Q0|` is at least 16, 16, 15 and 12 at ranks 3, 4, 5 and 6. Rank 7 has no pair floor.
- Rank 3 forces the layer-1 projection to be the whole 3-flat. The complementary arc then needs at least four height steps, leaving only the shapes `(a, q, k) = (7, 16, 5)` and `(8, 16, 4)`.
- An exhaustive placement search on the 108 canonical 4-cube walks misses at least two vectors outside the 3-flat. The minimum is 2, so no such word is universal.

Combined with the cited rank-at-most-2 obstruction, every multiplicity-2 sojourn of a universal length-30 word has rank at least 4. The rank-3 half does not use that citation or the bent census. Existence at rank at least 4 remains open. Heuristic misses are not offered as a nonexistence proof. Length 28 is not treated. The length-32 Gray concatenation remains a universal upper example. The recorded coverage-255 word, missing only mask 131, has sojourn ranks 6, 4 and 7 and still meets the new floors.

## Task and overlap

Base commit: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.

Session r119, the length-30 arc under the sojourn constraints. The assigned item is discussion #1166 comment 19377982. The predecessor record is upstream pull request 6943, head `c1cf726df3a06e50ef655ae91e8c8aac942b19a7` (fork pull request 154). Its open question is this search. This package does not rerun the rank-at-most-2 obstruction, the bent census, the 4+4 prefix-set argument, or the length-28 sharpness question.

Card `connector-alphabet-change`, priority revision 8. Scope status: **changed**. The card asks for one new connector operation. This package stays in the published singleton alphabet and closes only the rank-3 case of the length-30 question.

Nearest work:

- #6943 records the low-rank, bent, and 4+4 obstructions and leaves rank at least 3 open. This package starts there.
- #3058 leaves the eight-source question open and proves `f(7)=24`, cited and not replayed.
- #5234 / `research/eight-source-singleton-floor` proves `28 <= f(8) <= 32`. Length 28 is not revisited.
- #5430 is the fixed-projection lift obstruction. This split does not reuse it.
- #1185 supplies the length-32 Gray upper bound, checked here as a positive control.
- Open-PR search on 2026-11-10 found #6943 and no other length-30 arc-search package. The latest top-level comments visible on discussion #1166 run through comment 19481299 (2026-11-09). Comment ids 19377982 and 19492995 did not resolve through the API at submission time; #6943 is the public predecessor record.

## Validation

CPython 3.12 and gcc, standard library, from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/length30-arc-sumset/verify.py
python3 -O -B research/length30-arc-sumset/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/length30-arc-sumset
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/length30-arc-sumset --check-source-history
```

Observed:

- `PASS_LENGTH30_ARC_SUMSET rank3=none best_miss=2 walks=108 floors=16,16,15,12`
- `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/length30-arc-sumset outcome=partial`
- `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` at `c5b463fe80dd0bcc234c12a6b1ed688ae855db06`, source pin `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`

The C search scores 224164584 placements in the five-height family and 9418680 in the four-height family. The canonical-walk digest is `3e51cc130c3e6c15`, recomputed in Python from the 108 orbits of 2592 quotient walks. A fixed control word misses 60 outside vectors in both the packed model and the length-30 prefix layers. Height words of length at most 3 are exhausted on arcs of length at most 21; none spans `F_2^3`. The coverage-255 witness and a swapped-pair failure control are checked. The Gray concatenation of length 32 is universal. `f(7)=24` was not replayed. Rank 4 and higher were not searched. The unpublished anneal was not replayed. No Lean, Docker, or selected cold replay was run.

## Credit

Ross Richardson, #943, for the singleton model and prefix criterion. Douglas Colkitt, #1185, for the length-32 construction. conorholds, #3058, for `f(7)=24` and the eight-source question. Nick Petalas, #5234 and discussion comment 19377982, for the deletion floor and the length-30 handoff. Nicholas Stone, #5430, for the fixed-projection lift obstruction that this split does not reuse. Upstream pull request 6943 for the rank-at-most-2 obstruction, the bent lower bound, the 4+4 argument, and the coverage-255 witness.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. New work is Apache-2.0. Independent human and proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

1. Does a universal length-30 word exist when every multiplicity-2 sojourn has rank at least 4, with at least 16, 15 and 12 layer-0 projections at ranks 4, 5 and 6? A yes answer lowers the upper bound on `f(8)` from 32 to 30. The coverage-255 witness meets these floors and misses only mask 131, so there is no one-mask counting contradiction yet. First step: fix one multiplicity-2 source whose open sojourn has rank 4 and whose layer-1 projection has between 8 and 14 points, then search the complementary arc with at least 16 layer-0 projections.
2. Does a universal length-28 word with multiplicities `(4,4,4,4,4,4,2,2)` exist? That is the sharpness question of #5234 and is not considered here.

## Workflow feedback

The quotient-coordinate relabeling reduces 2592 walks to 108 orbits, which makes the two rank-3 families a single exhaustive pass. No further session report.
